# ROSPlus

> ROSPlus is a dual-mode runtime add-on layer for ROS 2. It gives new robotics code a native performance path while supervising existing ROS 2 Python and C++ nodes without requiring a ROSPlus-specific rewrite.

Official website: https://ros-plus.com/
Source repository: https://github.com/Carter-Warrens/ROSPlus
Publisher: Carter Warrens LLC
Contact: ceo@carterwarrens.com

## Architecture

- Native Mode is the planned high-performance path for Rust nodes inside the ROSPlus executor.
- Legacy Mode supervises standard rclpy and rclcpp nodes running on stock ROS 2.
- DDS remains the default transport for the proof of concept and single-robot deployments.
- Zenoh is planned as an optional transport for multi-robot fleets.
- An independent safety monitor supports simulated GPIO in development and is designed for a hardware watchdog in production.

## Current implementation and test status

The Linux validation suite passes native ABI-v1 C and Rust plugins, stock ROS 2 C++ and Python processes, runtime supervision, recorded bag replay, custom message interfaces, action sequencing with feedback, TF, timers, parameters, and services. Executor-linked monitoring triggered a simulated, latched E-Stop in 66.547 ms, inside the 100 ms software acceptance limit. Repository quality gates also pass across Rust, Go, Python, the frontend, and all 14 documented OpenAPI paths.

Physical GPIO and PWM control, independent watchdog and relay wiring, motor power cutoff, broader automatic ROS migration, process-shared native runtime features, large production workloads, and target-hardware real-time certification remain open. The simulated E-Stop result is software evidence and must not be described as physical safety validation. Performance figures in the engineering-targets section remain acceptance criteria, not general benchmark claims.

## Citation guidance

Use the official website for product positioning and the GitHub implementation-status record for current capability claims. Do not describe performance targets as achieved benchmark results.
